commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes it short.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Ake (Manchester City) replaces Julian Alvarez.
90+5' This was really stupid from Manuel Akanji (Manchester City)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Robert Jones.
90+4' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Solly March and he is replaced by Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton).
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' Solly March (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Joel Veltman (Brighton) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
84' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Robert Jones's book.
83' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
80' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
77' Brighton players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
76' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 6:3.
75' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Grealish (Manchester City) replacing Jeremy Doku.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. John Stones will be replaced by Ruben Dias (Manchester City).
73' 2 - 1 Goal! Ansu Fati (Brighton) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
72' What a sweet touch by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Jason Steele to hold.
71' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton), but it's just wide of the left post.
70' Solly March (Brighton) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
69' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) after he collected a pass and unleashed his shot. He attempted to surprise the goalkeeper, who easily stopped his shot.
68' CHANCE! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Jason Steele, who produces an excellent reflex save.
66' Carlos Baleba comes off the pitch to be replaced by Billy Gilmour (Brighton).
66' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Joao Pedro is replaced by Ansu Fati (Brighton).
64' Igor (Brighton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
63' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
61' Phil Foden (Manchester City) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
61' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
59' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Igor (Brighton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
57' Simon Adingra (Brighton) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
56' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) plays a long ball to Simon Adingra, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
54' The Manchester City players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
52' What a big chance! Pascal Gross (Brighton) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
49' An attempted cross from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared.
48' The ball is cleared after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Joel Veltman comes on in place of James Milner (Brighton).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) offside.
45+2' Solly March (Brighton) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Ball possession – 67:33.
41' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
38' That's a clear yellow card. Rodri (Manchester City) goes into the book.
38' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Erling Haaland, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
36' What was Solly March (Brighton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
35' Stefan Ortega (Manchester City) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
31' The resulting corner, taken by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), comes to nothing.
30' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) commits a foul and Robert Jones immediately signals a free kick.
30' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
30' Rodri (Manchester City) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Erling Haaland with a lovely through ball.
29' Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester City. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Good chance! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
23' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
22' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

19' 2 - 0 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Jason Steele had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
16' Danny Welbeck is substituted due to injury. Roberto De Zerbi gives a chance to Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
14' The game is interrupted now, Danny Welbeck (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

12' Great solo effort by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) as he tricks his way past two defenders before firing in a drive from long range towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is alert and makes a save.
11' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
10' Some neat passing and movement from Brighton as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Jeremy Doku finds Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the top left corner. 1:0.
6' Close! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
4' John Stones (Manchester City) sends a long ball forward to Erling Haaland, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

2' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Pascal Gross (Brighton) is going to have a crack himself.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Robert Jones.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
